"No" — used to negate nouns. Is this an apple?  No, it's an orange.
"Not yet" — used when something has not happened (yet). Have you already eaten the apple? No, not yet.
"Don't" — to tell somebody not to do something. Don't eat the apple!
"Forbidden" — used mostly on signs. Eating apple is forbidden.
